pricing.heading: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.subheading: No hidden fees. Pay only for what you ship.
pricing.note: Prices shown are for 3kg packages. Heavier packages may have different rates.
pricing.weightSplitting: Smart weight splitting: Packages over 31.5kg are automatically split for optimal pricing
pricing.pageSubtitle: Calculate your shipping costs instantly. No hidden fees, no surprises.
pricing.smartSplittingDesc: Packages over 31.5kg are automatically split into multiple shipments to find the optimal price combination. Our system calculates the cheapest way to ship heavy packages.
pricing.smartSplittingExample: A 40kg package to Austria might be split as 25kg + 15kg = €9.10 + €7.50 = €16.60 total

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: We offer transparent per-package pricing based on weight and destination. There are no monthly fees or subscriptions - you only pay for what you ship. Prices start from €5.80 for domestic Austrian shipments.
faq.q2: What countries can I ship to?
faq.a2: We currently support 29 European countries including Germany, Austria, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, and more. See our full coverage map for details.
faq.q3: How do I get tracking numbers?
faq.a3: Tracking numbers are added by our logistics team when your package is dispatched. They appear automatically in your dashboard and you'll be notified immediately.
faq.q4: Is there a minimum shipment volume?
faq.a4: No minimums required. Ship one package or thousands - you get the same competitive rates. BlueLogistic is designed to scale with your business.
faq.a5: Most businesses are creating their first shipping labels within 10 minutes of signing up. Just create an account, enter your company details, and you're ready to go.
faq.q6: Can I integrate with my e-commerce platform?
faq.a6: Yes! API access is available for custom integrations. We're also working on native Shopify and WooCommerce plugins. Contact us to discuss your integration needs.
faq.generalA1: BlueLogistic is a B2B package management platform for European shipping. We help businesses ship packages across Europe with transparent pricing and easy-to-use tools.
faq.generalA2: BlueLogistic is designed for e-commerce businesses, online sellers, and companies that need to ship packages across Europe.
faq.generalA3: BlueLogistic operates from Austria and ships to 29 European countries.
faq.pricingA1: We offer transparent per-package pricing based on weight and destination. There are no monthly fees or subscriptions.
faq.pricingA2: No hidden fees. The price you see is the price you pay. We believe in full transparency.
faq.pricingQ3: How is the selling price calculated?
faq.pricingA3: The selling price is typically 2x the cost price, giving you a healthy margin on each shipment.
faq.pricingA4: Packages over 31.5kg are automatically split into multiple shipments for optimal pricing.
faq.shippingQ1: What countries can I ship to?
faq.shippingA1: We support 29 European countries including Germany, Austria, France, Italy, Spain, and more.
faq.shippingQ2: How do I create a shipping label?
faq.shippingA2: Simply add your package details in the dashboard and click 'Create Label'. It takes under 60 seconds.
faq.shippingA3: We work with multiple reliable carriers to ensure the best service for each destination.
faq.shippingA4: Delivery times vary by destination, typically 2-5 business days within Europe.
faq.trackingQ1: How do I get tracking numbers?
faq.trackingA1: Tracking numbers are added when your package is dispatched and appear automatically in your dashboard.
faq.trackingQ2: Can my customers track their packages?
faq.trackingA2: Yes! You can share tracking numbers with your customers for full visibility.
faq.trackingQ3: What do the status badges mean?
faq.trackingA3: Created = Package entered, In Storage = Received at warehouse, Dispatched = Shipped with carrier.
faq.accountQ1: How do I create an account?
faq.accountA1: Click 'Get Started Free' and fill in your details. It takes less than 2 minutes.
faq.accountA2: Yes! There are no subscription fees. You only pay for the packages you ship.
faq.accountQ3: How do I add team members?
faq.accountA3: Contact our support team to add additional users to your account.
faq.integrationsA1: Native plugins are coming soon. In the meantime, you can use our API for custom integrations.
faq.integrationsA2: Yes! We offer API access for custom integrations. Contact us for documentation.
faq.integrationsQ3: How do I import orders via CSV?
faq.integrationsA3: Upload your CSV file in the dashboard and we'll automatically create packages from your orders.
